correctness.rationale: For P(s)=a m^-s + b n^-s, m<n integers, the global Bohr fourth mean is u^4+4u²v²+v^4. If m>=2, the pointwise bound (u+v)/sqrt2 and factorization 8D-3(1+x)^4=(x-1)^2(5x²-2x+5)>=0 give ratio <=2/3. If m=1,n>=3, pointwise bound u+v/sqrt3 and positive decomposition 3(1+12y²+9y^4)-2(1+y)^4=(1-4y)^2+y²(25y²-8y+8)>0 give ratio <3/2. The 1,2 pair has exact local integral as a cos(phi),cos2phi polynomial; both harmonic coefficients positive, so unique maximizing relative phase phi=0. Its x-ratio derivative numerator is -A x^6/2+(2-2B)x^5-Ax^4-3x^3-5Ax²/2+(2B-8)x+A, strictly decreasing in x>0 since 2<B<3, hence unique positive optimizer xi. F(1/2)>3/2 establishes strict pair rigidity; zero-coefficient cases <=1. Independent symbolic factorization and derivative checks and bisection yield xi=0.4441040639694337, C=1.6076693260885673. No inference about unrestricted C4 is made.
